sn56.13:1.3: Dukkham ariyasaccaṃ || dukkhasamudayam ariya- || dukkhanirodham ariya- dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || 3.
sn56.13:3.2: Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatra tatatrābhinandinī || seyyathīdaṃ
sn56.13:4.2: Yo tassā yeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo || ||
sn56.13:5.2: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdam ||
sn56.13:5.4: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || 7.
sn56.13:6.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave || Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
